definitions.full: H2658. chaphar I. חָפַר verb dig, search for (Arabic id. ; Aramaic חֲפַר , , id. ; Late Hebrew חֵפֶר act of digging ) — Qal Perfect ׳ח Job 39:29 ; וְחָפַרְתָּ֫ 11:18 ; וְחָפַרְתָּ֫ה Deut 23:14 ; חָפַרְתִּי Gen 21:30 ; חָֽפְרוּ 26:18 2 t.; חָפָ֑רוּ 26:32 ; חֲפָרוּהָ Num 21:18 ; Imperfect וַיַּחְמֹּר Gen 26:18 , 22 ; וַיַּחְמְּרֵהוּ Psa 7:16 ; וָאֶחְמֹּר Jer 13:7 ; יַחְמְּרוּ Job Job 39:21 (but read יַחְמֹּר so ᵑ6 ᵑ9 ᵐ5 Di) Deut 1:22 ; וַיַּחְמְּרוּ Gen 26:19 2 t.; וַיַּחְמְּרֻהוּ Job 3:21 ; Infinitive construct לַחְמֹּר Josh 2:2-3 ,+ Isa 2:20 (compare below); Participle חֹפֵר Eccl 10:8 ; — 1 dig: a. a well, with accusative בְּאֵר Gen 21:30 (E), 26:15 , 18 (twice in verse); 26:19 , 21 , 22 , 32 (J), Num 21:18 (E); compare Exod 7:24 (E); dig (a hole, implied as object) Deut 23:14 ; a pit, with hostile purpose, as snare or trap, figurative of malicious plan, with accusative בּוֺר Psa 7:16 (|| כָּרָה ); so with accusative גומץ Eccl 10:8 , compare [ שַׁחַת ] ׳ח לְנַפְשִׁי Psa 35:7 ; of horse, dig , i.e. paw the ground, בָּעֵמֶק יַחְמֹּר Job 39:21 (so read, see above) he paweth in the valley (compare Arabic hoof ). b. dig for something hidden, with accusative Job 3:21 (figurative of longing for death), Jer 13:7 (no object expressed) 2 search, search out, explore , with accusative הָאָרֶץ Josh 2:3 (twice in verse) (JE), Deut 1:22 ; of eagle, search for food, with accusative ׳ח אֹכֶל Job 39:29 , with especially reference to keen vision (|| יַבִּיטוּ עֵינָיו מֵרָחוֺק ); so = search or look carefully about before going to rest 11:18 (no object). — לַחְמֹּר Isa 2:20 see חֲפַרְמָּרָה below
